title: Perfect
content:
Capo: 1st fret
Play: G
Key: Ab

For chords in original key transpose this chord sheet +1 (and "use flats").

Play this song with the regular shapes of the chords given in this song
or use the ones that can be heard on the recording:

      E-A-D-G-B-e
G     3-x-0-0-3(3)
Em    0-2-2-0-3(3) (= Em7)
C     x-3-2-0-3(3) (= Cadd9)
[Coda]
Dsus4 x-x-0-2-3-3 or x-x-0-0-3-3 (= a D chord which is neither major nor minor)
G/B   x-2-0-0-0-3  (= G chord with a "b" as the root)
D/F#  2-x-0-2-3-x  (= D chord with a "f#" as the root)

The "%" signs mean "repeat the bar before", so "| D | % |" = two bars of D. 
It's a common abbreviation. (Real Book etc.: https://www.swiss-jazz.ch/standards-jazz/AllOfMe.pdf)

title: The Scientist
content:
THE SCIENTIST (ACOUSTIC) - COLDPLAY

An incredibly simple but fantastic song to play on an acoustic guitar!
There seems to be a lot of confusion about the key of the song.
It does state below that a capo is required, but for those that don't have a capo,
I have taken the liberty of putting a set of chords on which do not require a capo
and will allow you to play along with the CD.

EDIT (08/05/2020) - it's been a long time since I originally submitted this and I must say it will NOT let
you play along to the song.  The tuning of the song is very unique.  I think it's tuned in 4ths
(which basically means the high b and e strings become c and f.  These strings are then played as open
throughout).  But even then it still doesn't quite sound right.

Oh well, I'm happy with my version as an acoustic...

title: Skyway

content:
Skyway
Capo 3rd fret

Tricky fingerpicking:
To get the feeling try playing the D chord and alternate the way you
play the last string between the 2nd fret (as in a D) and the open
string (D9). Do the same with the GM7 chord (alternate on the little
string between the second fret and the open string). I fingerpick the
whole song and it sounds ok.

For the D: easy to play for everybody...
1 E: 2  (alternate with open string (e))
2 B: 3
3 G: 2
4 D: 0
5 A: 0
6 E: X

For the GM7: hard to play for beginners...
1 E: 2  (alternate with open string (e))
2 B: 0
